const selfRotated = eda.sys_Math.rotate(mount, 90);
console.log('绕质心旋转后的顶点：', JSON.stringify(selfRotated));

const originRotated = eda.sys_Math.rotate(mount, 90, 0, 0);
console.log('绕原点旋转后的顶点：', JSON.stringify(originRotated));

_source.params.angle: 旋转角度（角度制，正值为逆时针）
_source.params.centerX: 旋转中心 X 坐标，默认为质心
_source.params.centerY: 旋转中心 Y 坐标，默认为质心

title: Rotate the polygon
params.angle: Rotation angle (in degrees, positive values are counterclockwise)
params.centerX: X coordinate of the rotation center, defaulting to the centroid
params.centerY: Y coordinate of the rotation center, defaulting to the centroid
returns: Array of discrete points after rotation
